main_text.p: mihi per alios authores, vel Canonicos, vel probabiles rationes, quod à vero nō abhorreat perfuadere potuerunt.

Et Paulo post ibidem. Quis nesciat.) Quis nesciat Sacram Scripturam Canonicam, tam veteris quam noui testamenti, certis terminis suis contineri, eamq; posterioribus omnibus Episcoporum literis ita præponi, vt de illa omnino dubitari & disceptari non posfit, vtrum verum vel vtrum rectum sit, quicquid in ea scripturn fit vel constiterit esse : Episcoporum autem literas, quæ post confirmatum Canonem, vel scriptæ sunt, vel scribuntur, & per sermonem forte sapientiorum in ea re cuiuslibet peritioris, & per aliorum Episcoporum grauiorem authoritatem, doctioremq; prudentiam, & per Concilia licere reprehendi, si quid in eis forte à veritate deuiatum est.

Item ibidem C. Noli frater.) Noli frater contra diuina tam multa, tam præclara, tā indubitata testimonia colligere velle calumnias ex Episcoporum scriptis, siue noftrorum, sicut Hilarij, siue Cypriani, & Agrippini, antequā pars Donati separaretur, primoq; hoc genus literarum, ab authoritate Canonum distinguendum est. Non enim sic legūtur, tanquā ita ex eis testimonium proferatur, vt contra sentire non liceat, sicubi forte aliter sapuerint, quàm veritas postulat

page.notes: The printed text is a scan of a 17th-century Latin page with a running head "SENTENTIAE DE" (truncated, as printed). No page number is printed. The first line is a continuation from the previous page. Doubtful readings: "scripturn" in "quicquid in ea scripturn fit" is likely the printed "scriptum" with a damaged letter; "Hilarij" and "Agrippini" read as printed; "legūtur" may be "legitur" with a tilde as printed. The word "posfit" and "constiterit" are read as printed. The left-margin marks beside the two paragraphs (sigils such as "C." and the underlined "Quis nesciat") appear to be in-text marginal references and no separate marginal note text is legible; they are transcribed as printed in the body. The page ends mid-sentence with "postulat" on the last line, which is right-aligned and set apart; the text continues on the next page. No catchword is legible.
